name: SafeWatch-Bench-200K-720P
description: A large-scale 720p visual dataset intended for safety-monitoring research, measuring models' ability to detect and classify safety-relevant events/objects in surveillance-style footage. It emphasizes high-resolution inputs and large sample counts to benchmark detection, classification, and temporal localization under realistic conditions. The benchmark is designed for evaluating robustness and scalability of vision models in safety-critical monitoring scenarios.
evaluation_method: mean_average_precision (mAP) for detection; accuracy/F1 for classification
reputation: A sizeable, recent dataset that is gaining attention for surveillance and safety research but is not yet a broadly established community standard.
